summary.text: Rhashanna Grant is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A web developer, she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rhashanna Grant graduated from Wichita South High School and attended Butler Community College.
Her career experience includes working as a web developer.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Cherokee Native American with deep roots in Wichita and said her work history includes roles as a para-educator, phlebotomist, EKG monitor tech and search engine optimization specialist.
She also said she performs as a stand-up comedian.
Grant wrote that hardworking families in South Wichita and Haysville are feeling the pinch of inflation and that state government should prioritize financial relief.
She also called for a regulated medical cannabis framework in Kansas and for action on rising property valuations, and she listed the right to abortion and bodily autonomy among her policy interests.
